content.text: In Nigeria, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-software-without-stripe-account-explained-digital-creators-3|selling]] software without Stripe or PayPal isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a structural lock. These platforms exclude entire regions based on financial policies, not technical merit. Digital creators in Nigeria face a binary choice: abandon global markets or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-until-you|Do Not]] sovereign infrastructure. This post breaks down how to deploy a commerce stack that operates independently of centralized payment processors. It’s not a workaround; it’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-digital-art-without-paypal-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]. You own the hosting, the backend logic, the order storage, and the file delivery. Payments are verified on-chain via NOWPayments, bypassing KYC and platform dependency. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is one example of this model in action. By the end of this post, you’ll understand exactly how this infrastructure works—and why it’s the only permanent solution for creators in regions Stripe has locked out.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Software stripe

This is not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a combination of free and paid services assembled into a self-owned commerce stack. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. The key is ownership: you control every layer. No platform can shut you down, freeze your account, or dictate your fees. Stripe excludes Nigeria due to perceived financial risk, not technical incapacity. This stack removes Stripe from the equation entirely. It’s built for creators who sell digital products—ebooks, templates, plugins—and need a system that operates regardless of geographic or policy restrictions. The result is infrastructure sovereignty: you own the tools, the data, and the process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is static HTML/CSS hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed. The backend uses Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Workers are serverless functions that execute JavaScript on Cloudflare’s edge network. Apps Script is simpler but equally effective for basic logic. Orders are stored in Supabase (a Postgres database) or Google Sheets. Supabase offers more scalability; Sheets is easier to set up. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable, but R2 is more cost-effective for large volumes. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers file delivery. No buyer account is required, and the fee is 0.5%. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. The entire system is modular: swap components as needed without rebuilding from scratch.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and cannot collect payment through conventional channels, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. With this stack, you own the code, the data, and the process. There are no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no shutdown risks. It’s built for creators who prioritize sovereignty over convenience. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing. It’s not the cheapest option, but it’s the only one that gives you full ownership. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or any region Stripe excludes, this is how you reclaim your market access.
Stripe excludes regions based on policy, not technology. This stack removes Stripe from the equation.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost, and ease of integration. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures your storefront is always online. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, triggering file delivery via webhook. The system is designed to minimize dependencies. For example, if Google Sheets goes down, you can switch to Supabase without disrupting operations. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes all these components pre-configured, plus 5 products loaded and 30-day support. It’s not just a collection of tools—it’s a tested, integrated system. Every component is replaceable, but the architecture remains intact. This is how you build a commerce stack that outlasts platform restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your requirements. Do you need high scalability? Use Supabase and Cloudflare R2. Prefer simplicity? Choose Google Sheets and Drive. Select your payment network—BSC, Solana, or TRON are cost-effective. Deploy the frontend on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Write the backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script. Test the webhook integration with NOWPayments. Load your products and configure file delivery. If this sounds complex, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles deployment for you. It’s not a DIY kit—it’s a fully operational system delivered in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation if you prefer to build it yourself. Either way, the outcome is the same: a commerce stack you own, control, and can operate from anywhere. This is how you sell software without Stripe—not as a workaround, but as a superior architecture.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured sovereign commerce infrastructure designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. It includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The stack is deployed in 48 hours, comes with 5 products loaded, and includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. You own the entire system after deployment, with no ongoing fees or platform dependencies. It’s built to provide permanent market access, not a temporary workaround.
You own every component after deployment. No platform can shut you down or dictate fees.

If you’re ready to deploy this architecture today, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a fully operational solution delivered in 48 hours. It includes all components pre-configured, plus 5 products loaded and 30-day support. For those who prefer to build their own stack, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation and source code. Both options give you infrastructure sovereignty—no platform dependencies, no subscriptions, and lifetime access. Choose the path that fits your needs, but choose sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Select backend logic: Cloudflare Workers (serverless JavaScript) or Google Apps Script (simpler). 3. Decide on order storage: Supabase (scalable) or Google Sheets (easy). 4. Set up file delivery: Google Drive (familiar) or Cloudflare R2 (cost-effective). 5. Integrate payment verification: NOWPayments (300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee). 6. Test the webhook: Ensure file delivery triggers when payment confirms on-chain. 7. Load your products: Upload files and configure delivery links. 8. Deploy: Push your code to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 9. Configure email: Set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC for order confirmations. 10. Test end-to-end: Place a test order to verify the entire flow.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is pre-configured and deployed for you in 48 hours. You don’t need to write code. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes step-by-step documentation and source code.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a verification layer, not a custody service. If it fails, payments still confirm on-chain. You can manually verify transactions or switch to another verification service without disrupting your stack.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. Since you own the system, you control the refund process. There’s no platform to approve or deny refunds.
Can I scale this stack for thousands of orders?

Yes. Use Supabase for order storage and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Both are designed for high scalability. Cloudflare Workers can handle millions of requests per second, making it suitable for large volumes.
What if I want to add more products later?

The stack is modular. You can add products by uploading files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and updating your backend logic. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes 5 products loaded, but you can expand it yourself afterward.
